title: Green Cord content update manifest
description: The document the school site hosts so the app can discover newer handbook content. Data only - it can never deliver code.

schemaVersion.description: Shape of this manifest. The app refuses a manifest whose schemaVersion it does not understand.

contentVersion.description: Sortable content version, YYYY.MM.DD. The app applies an update only when this is strictly greater than what it already has.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp, for humans and for the update log.

files.description: Every file in the payload. The app downloads each one, checks its SHA-256, and discards the whole update if any file fails.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL. Plain HTTP is rejected by the app.
